gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioma; CNS Tumor, Adult; CNS Tumor, Childhood
Histologically proven diagnosis of central nervous system (CNS) malignant tumor: IDH-mutant high-grade glioma, other high-grade glioma, or other high-grade CNS tumors.

candidate_evidence.quote: then tarlatamab at 10mg every D1 & D15 of each 4-week cycle thereafter in combination with temozolomide from C2D1.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Confirmed progressive or refractory disease after at least one line of standard therapy containing radiotherapy and for which no further effective standard therapy exists.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Exploratory analyses in tumor will be performed in an effort to understand the association of DLL3 expression with treatment response.

role_evidence.quote: Combination of Tarlatamab and Temozolomide in Patients With Central Nervous System Tumors
Metronomic temozolomide will not be administered during the first cycle.

source_quote.quote: Tumors expressing DLL3 based on IHC staining performed on archival tumor sample

coder_notes: Glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title, eligibility or arm labels, so S5 = high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Temozolomide is a fixed metronomic backbone given to all, coded soc_backbone; tarlatamab is the only investigational agent. Target engagement: DLL3 expression during treatment is an exploratory tumour biomarker linked to the target and response, not clearly a pharmacodynamic modulation endpoint; coded unclear. Cohorts are histology-defined (IDH-mutant glioma / other glioma / other CNS tumours).
